theme: Behavioural finance: volatility ≠ loss, avoiding panic selling, staying invested
headline: Market Swings Don't Mean You Lost Money
body: Volatility is normal market behavior. Panic selling during dips often locks in losses. Staying invested through cycles helps achieve goals.
caption: Markets fluctuate, but temporary dips aren't permanent losses. Emotional decisions during volatility often hurt long-term outcomes. Discipline and patience matter more than timing. #BehaviouralFinance #MarketVolatility #InvestingWisdom #StayCalm #LongTermThinking
